description: Analyze the provided codebase to identify security vulnerabilities, correctness bugs, test failures, and performance issues. This is a straightforward code review task with a clear buggy implementation and contradicting tests. Inspect all required files listed in the manifest, identify the seeded issues, classify their severity correctly, and write a final report documenting all findings with supporting evidence. Focus on path traversal vulnerabilities, stub functions, access control bypasses, and off-by-one errors.
